verdict.rationale: The agentic-commerce docs are served as raw markdown with frontmatter: shopify.dev/docs/agents.md probed HTTP 200, and every agents page has a .md variant. Shopify also ships an AI Toolkit plugin and skill so assistants can drive the UCP CLI from natural language, and the UCP spec Shopify co-develops publishes a versioned llms.txt at ucp.dev. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index on shopify.dev itself (probed 404) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).
